records.title: HM Treasury awards HSBC Orion the platform mandate for DIGIT, the pilot digital gilt — on track to be the first G7 sovereign bond issued on a distributed ledger.
records.text: HM Treasury awards HSBC Orion the platform mandate for DIGIT, the pilot digital gilt — on track to be the first G7 sovereign bond issued on a distributed ledger. Britain shelves the digital pound and tokenizes the debt instead. The state ledger that survives is the one that holds the borrowing.
kv: Digital pound: shelved vs design decision pending: 3 readings disagree — World money record (dated rows) (May 1, 2026); World money record (dated rows) (February 12, 2026); UK legal map (on-ledger overlay) (September 14, 2026). Unresolved; every reading is shown on this page.

records.title: The Thai cabinet approves the G-Token — five billion baht of state borrowing issued as a digital token the public can buy in small pieces.
records.text: The Thai cabinet approves the G-Token — five billion baht of state borrowing issued as a digital token the public can buy in small pieces. Not a CBDC: the state tokenizes its debt, not its money. The same instinct as Britain's digital gilt, reached from Bangkok.
